provenance: Generated locally with OpenCV geometry and NumPy; no downloaded or real photos.
coordinate_system: image pixels; origin top-left; x right; y down
mask_definition: uint8 PNG; 255=true target, 0=background or distractor; exactly one true target per image
interpretation: Candidate counts are expected color-detector outputs, not ground-truth object counts. The last two cases intentionally demonstrate failure.

images.scene_en: A 160 x 120 pixel blue rectangle on a uniform light background.
images.scene_zh: 均匀浅色背景上的蓝色矩形，宽 160、高 120 像素。

images.scene_en: A blue circle with orange/green rectangles and tiny blue speckles.
images.scene_zh: 蓝色圆形目标，旁边有橙色、绿色矩形及微小蓝色噪点。

images.scene_en: A small blue ellipse (semi-axes 32 and 25 pixels) on a noisy light background.
images.scene_zh: 浅色低幅噪声背景上的小蓝色椭圆，长短半轴为 32 和 25 像素。

images.scene_en: A real target is present, but its HSV value V=50 is below the configured lower bound V=70.
images.scene_zh: 目标确实存在，但亮度 V=50 低于默认阈值下限 70，预期漏检。
images.deliberate_failure: false_negative: target V=50 is below default V lower bound 70

images.scene_en: The rectangle is the true target; a separate larger blue circle is a same-color distractor.
images.scene_zh: 左侧矩形是真实目标，右侧更大的同色圆形是干扰物；纯颜色算法会输出两个候选。
images.deliberate_failure: false_positive: same-color distractor cannot be rejected by color and area alone
